repository.name: serlo-abc
repository.description: App to provide free and open source literacy training for refugees

issue.body:
Updates to Expo SDK 20 and React Native 0.47

## Respective Expo / React Native changelogs

* https://blog.expo.io/expo-sdk-v18-0-0-is-now-available-38e62305283
* https://blog.expo.io/expo-sdk-v19-0-0-is-now-available-821a62b58d3d
* https://blog.expo.io/expo-sdk-v20-0-0-is-now-available-79f84232a9d1
* https://github.com/facebook/react-native/releases/tag/v0.45.1
* https://github.com/facebook/react-native/releases/tag/v0.46.4
* https://github.com/facebook/react-native/releases/tag/v0.47.0

## Resolved issues

#98 (finally 👍)

## Breaking changes

@Knorrke @vhaller 
* `yarn start` doesn't start the storybook anymore because `react-native-scripts` now has an interactive UI (e.g. for restarting the packager, changing to a production build). So you also have to run `yarn storybook` in a new terminal.
* Because of some port changes in Expo, I changed the storybook port to the default 7007. But the app tells you that, anyways.

## Regressions

#126

body:
Fixed by: npm install --save-dev babel-preset-es2015

Then add .babelrc file to storybook folder with the es2015 in presets.

Screenshot: https://gyazo.com/2e7b0214dc9f217391b242f4b045807d
@inspireui Thanks, nice workaround. I modified the `.babelrc` in root, didn't think about creating one in `storybook` directory. 😅

It looks like our move from babel `es-2015` to `env` caused some unexpected packages to break.

Does someone want to submit a PR for this? a custom `.babelrc` is definitely not the solution if CRNA doesn't work out of the box.

issue.title: Fix crna+storybook

repository.name: react-inspector
repository.description: 🔍 Power of Browser DevTools inspectors right inside your React app

issue.body:
### Context
[Storybook](https://github.com/storybooks/storybook) recently switched to [babel-preset-env](https://github.com/babel/babel-preset-env) 

 https://github.com/storybooks/storybook/commit/8ab7bda83e25c37b79936bef510a2d391af4f548#diff-1327a902195fd9d1fb95d4671da92a42

For some reason, greenfield CRNA projects are picking up the `.babelrc` file in this libary
- https://github.com/storybooks/storybook/issues/1831
- https://github.com/storybooks/storybook/issues/1875

### Solution
Add `.babelrc` to `npmignore`
Republish the package

I took the liberty of ignoring the rest of the dev files in root
